start: Enquiries on the owner login; a person walks in and asks about joining

steps.action: Open Enquiries and start adding one
user_sees: Page "Enquiries" with "People who asked about joining"

Sheet "Add enquiry" with "Name", "Code", "Mobile number", "Interested in (optional)", "Where did they hear about us? (optional)" (Walk-in, Instagram, Friend, Google, Justdial, Other, or "Not asked") and "Follow-up date" set to tomorrow with "Call back on <day> (tomorrow)"
must_not: A follow-up date of today or empty by default

steps.action: Fill it in and save
user_sees: The person in the list under the later group, with their number and what they asked about
must_not: Two rows after a double tap
The number saved without its country code

steps.action: On the follow-up day, open Enquiries
user_sees: The person under the due group, with "Call", "WhatsApp", "Add as member", "Follow-up date" and "Not interested"
must_not: A due enquiry missing from the due count in the menu

steps.action: Tap "WhatsApp"
user_sees: WhatsApp opens with "Hi <first name>, you asked about <gym> (<interest>)." then "Would you like to start this week? Reply here if you have any questions, or come to the gym." and "– <gym>"; nothing is sent until the user presses send
must_not: A message sent by itself
A note the gym wrote for itself, or the web page note "Asked on your web page: …" or "Joined online: …", inside the message

start: Other ways in: the address /enquiries/new, and an enquiry that came from the gym web page or the online join page

steps.action: Open /enquiries/new
user_sees: Enquiries with the "Add enquiry" sheet already open
must_not: The list only, with no sheet

steps.action: Open an enquiry that came from the web page
user_sees: The line "Asked on your web page" (or "Chat on your web page" with the whole chat) in place of the raw note
A visitor who only chatted shows "No number left yet" and no Call or WhatsApp button
must_not: A Call or WhatsApp button with no number behind it
The raw server note shown twice

steps.action: Save with everything empty
user_sees: "Type their name." on the name box
must_not: An enquiry saved with no name

steps.action: Type a name, leave the number empty; then type 12345
user_sees: "Type their mobile number.", then "This mobile number looks wrong. Check it and type it again."
must_not: A wrong number saved
An empty box called "wrong"

steps.action: Paste "+91 98765 43210" into the number box
user_sees: The box keeps 9876543210
must_not: The country code doubled

steps.action: Set a follow-up date of yesterday
user_sees: "The follow-up date can’t be in the past."
must_not: An enquiry born overdue

steps.action: Type the number of a person who already has an open enquiry
user_sees: A warning that this number already asked; saving is still allowed
must_not: A silent second enquiry with no warning
A block that stops a family member with the same number

start: Enquiries, one open enquiry that is due today

steps.action: Tap "Follow-up date"
user_sees: Sheet "Call <name> again" with "Tomorrow", "In 3 days", "In a week" and "Or pick a date"
must_not: A past date accepted

steps.action: Pick "In 3 days"
user_sees: The enquiry moves to the later group; the due count goes down by one
must_not: The enquiry in both groups

steps.action: Tap "Not interested", pick a reason under "Why did <name> not join? (optional)"
user_sees: The pill "Not interested" with the reason; only "Reopen" is left
must_not: The person deleted
Call-back reminders still counted for a lost enquiry

steps.action: Tap "Reopen", then "Add as member" and finish the member form
user_sees: The enquiry shows as joined with "Open member"; a person already on the list gets "Already a member" (or "Already a member (archived)")
must_not: A second member with the same number
The enquiry left open after the member was saved without the line "The member was saved, but the enquiry was not closed."

start: Enquiries: who can see a person who only asked, and what leaves the gym

steps.action: Read "Where enquiries came from" and the list
user_sees: Only this gym (this branch) enquiries, with name, number and what they asked
must_not: Enquiries of another gym
The number of a web page visitor who did not leave one

steps.action: Open a web page chat older than 90 days
user_sees: A line that the chat messages were deleted 90 days after the last one
must_not: Old chat text still shown

steps.action: Tap "Mark as done" on a web page chat that waits for the owner
user_sees: The chat no longer waits
must_not: The enquiry itself closed or deleted
